fields.title: Short interest / short volume / SEC filing record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType discriminates the payload: SHORT_INTEREST (Nasdaq settlement-date rows), SHORT_VOLUME (FINRA daily per-symbol rows), FILING (one SEC filing), FILING_MATCH (an EDGAR full-text hit), COMPANY (SEC company profile), SYMBOL_INFO (Nasdaq listing info), SOURCE (reference mode) and ERROR. Dates are normalised to YYYY-MM-DD and formatted numbers are parsed, with the publisher's original values kept under _raw.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The ticker, CIK, date or query that produced this record.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: S1-nasdaq, S1-finra, S1-sec, S1-sec-fulltext, S1-probe, or 'none' on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: SHORT_INTEREST | SHORT_VOLUME | FILING | FILING_MATCH | COMPANY | SYMBOL_INFO | SOURCE | ERROR.

settlementDate.title: Settlement date
settlementDate.description: Short interest settlement date, normalised to YYYY-MM-DD. Nasdaq publishes twice a month.

shortInterest.title: Short interest
shortInterest.description: Shares held short at the settlement date, parsed from Nasdaq's formatted number.

avgDailyShareVolume.title: Avg daily share volume
avgDailyShareVolume.description: Average daily share volume over the period, as published by Nasdaq.

daysToCover.title: Days to cover
daysToCover.description: Nasdaq's own short interest / average daily volume ratio, passed through rather than recomputed.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Company name from Nasdaq or SEC, depending on the record type.

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.description: Listing exchange, e.g. NASDAQ or NYSE.

isNasdaqListed.title: Nasdaq listed
isNasdaqListed.description: Whether the symbol is Nasdaq-listed. Short interest is only published for symbols where this is true.

isNasdaq100.title: Nasdaq-100 member
isNasdaq100.description: Whether the symbol is part of the Nasdaq-100.

stockType.title: Security type
stockType.description: Security type as classified by Nasdaq, e.g. Common Stock.

lastSalePrice.title: Last sale price
lastSalePrice.description: Last traded price at scrape time (symbol info).

netChange.title: Net change
netChange.description: Price change on the day (symbol info).

percentageChange.title: Percentage change
percentageChange.description: Percentage change on the day, as published (symbol info).

date.title: Trading date
date.description: Trading day of a short-volume row, YYYY-MM-DD.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: Which FINRA file the row came from: consolidated, nasdaq-carteret, nasdaq-chicago, nyse or finra-adf.

shortVolume.title: Short volume
shortVolume.description: Shares sold short that day. Fractional values are genuine - they come from odd-lot and fractional-share executions.

shortExemptVolume.title: Short exempt volume
shortExemptVolume.description: Shares sold short under an exemption.

totalVolume.title: Total volume
totalVolume.description: Total reported share volume for that symbol and venue.

shortVolumeRatio.title: Short volume ratio
shortVolumeRatio.description: shortVolume / totalVolume, computed here so every consumer uses the same definition.

market.title: Market codes
market.description: Reporting market codes as published by FINRA, e.g. B,Q,N.

cik.title: CIK
cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, zero-padded to 10 digits.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: All tickers SEC associates with the company.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.description: Exchanges SEC associates with the company.

category.title: Filer category
category.description: SEC filer category, e.g. Large accelerated filer.

website.title: Website
website.description: Company website as filed with the SEC.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Business phone as filed with the SEC.

businessAddress.title: Business address
businessAddress.description: Business address as filed, joined into one line.

filingCount.title: Recent filings
filingCount.description: How many filings the company's recent-history block carries (SEC caps it at 1,000).

latestFilingDate.title: Latest filing date
latestFilingDate.description: Date of the company's most recent filing.

latestFilingForm.title: Latest filing form
latestFilingForm.description: Form type of the most recent filing.

formerNames.title: Former names
formerNames.description: Previous registered names of the company.

hasOlderFilingShards.title: Has older history
hasOlderFilingShards.description: True when the company has filings older than the 1,000 returned here, stored in SEC's archive shards.

rootForms.title: Root forms
rootForms.description: Base form types for a full-text match, e.g. ['8-K'] for an 8-K/A.

accessionNumber.title: Accession number
accessionNumber.description: SEC's unique identifier for the filing.

items.title: Items
items.description: Reported items for the form, e.g. 8-K item numbers.

primaryDocument.title: Primary document
primaryDocument.description: Filename of the filing's main document.

primaryDocDescription.title: Document description
primaryDocDescription.description: SEC's description of the main document.

isXBRL.title: XBRL
isXBRL.description: Whether the filing carries XBRL data.

isInlineXBRL.title: Inline XBRL
isInlineXBRL.description: Whether the filing uses inline XBRL.

filingUrl.title: Filing URL
filingUrl.description: Direct link to the filing's main document on sec.gov.

filingIndexUrl.title: Filing index URL
filingIndexUrl.description: Link to the filing's index page, which lists every attached document.

companyDisplayName.title: Company (search hit)
companyDisplayName.description: Company label as EDGAR full-text search returns it, including tickers and CIK.

fileDate.title: File date (search hit)
fileDate.description: Filing date of a full-text match.

periodEnding.title: Period ending (search hit)
periodEnding.description: Reporting period of a full-text match.

fileType.title: File type
fileType.description: Exhibit or document type of the matched file, e.g. EX-99.1.

fileDescription.title: File description
fileDescription.description: SEC's description of the matched document.

documentId.title: Document ID
documentId.description: EDGAR's accession:filename identifier for the matched document.

documentUrl.title: Document URL
documentUrl.description: Direct link to the matched document.

businessState.title: Business state
businessState.description: State of the filer's business address.

incorporationState.title: Incorporation state
incorporationState.description: State of incorporation on the matched filing.

relevanceScore.title: Relevance
relevanceScore.description: EDGAR's own relevance score for the match.

totalMatches.title: Total matches
totalMatches.description: How many documents matched the query in total. EDGAR caps a result set at 10,000.

url.title: Probed URL
url.description: Exact URL used for the probe.

isAvailable.title: Available
isAvailable.description: Whether that source answered with usable data right now.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Evidence measured during the probe, including the newest published FINRA date and row count.

_raw.title: Raw upstream record
_raw.description: The publisher's untouched row or object, so the formatted originals survive alongside the parsed values.

_error.title: Error kind
_error.description: not_found | not_published | not_in_file | empty_response | empty_section | invalid_symbol | invalid_date | no_matches | shape_changed | blocked_or_transient.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Human-readable detail, including what to do instead where the limit is the publisher's.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type.
